Name: Helpful Spouses and Roommates - Chore Options
Author: CaptainSully
Description:
[size=5]About[/size]
Want your spouse or roommate to be more helpful? Now, they can be!
The primary features are allowing roommates to do chores as well, and to configure the chance of each of the 5 vanilla and 2 (so far) custom chores being done each morning.

Here's the list of things you can now control about what chores your spouse/roommate will do each morning:[list]
[*][b]Roommates do chores[/b] - Allows roommates to do chores just like spouses. False in vanilla.
[*][b]Enable custom chores[/b] - Allows them to do custom chores added by this mod.
[*][b]Combine feed/pet for pets [/b]- Feeding and petting your pets is counted as one combined chore. Custom chores must be enabled.
[*][b]Combine feed/pet for animals [/b]- Feeding and petting your animals is counted as one combined chore. Custom chores must be enabled.
[*][b]Always water the pet bowl [/b]- Feeding your pets no longer counts as a chore, and they will ALWAYS do so.
[*][b]Always pet your pets[/b] - Petting your pets no longer counts as a chore, and they will ALWAYS do so.
[*][b]Green rain behaviour[/b] - How to handle chores if there is green rain.
[*][b]Chore dialogue[/b] - How to handle chore dialogue.
[*][b]Max chores per spouse[/b] - The maximum number of chores any single spouse/roommate can do each morning.
[/list]Multi-spouse options:
[list]
[*][b]Only one NPC does chores[/b] - Prevents multiple NPCs from doing chores. Only matters if you have some kind of multi-spouse mod. Each individual chore should still only be done once even if this is disabled.
[*][b]Max chores per day[/b] - The maximum number of chores than can be performed each morning, from 1 to the total number of available chores.
[/list]And finally, there is a specific option for each chore (currently 7):
[list]
[*][b]Chance for X[/b] - The chance, from 0-1 that they will add a given chore to their chores list.
[/list]The available chores are as follows,
Vanilla: Feed the pets, water the crops, feed the animals, repair fences, make breakfast
Custom: Pet your pets, pet the animals

The petting and feeding chores give normal friendship and/or xp, as if the farmer had done it themselves.

Based on the above choices, the NPC in question generates a chores list, and then attempts to perform the available chores at random until they hit the end of their list or reach 'Max chores per day'.



My todo list:
Add more chores. Feel free to offer suggestions in the comments.
Make options for simply asking someone to do a chore the next day (or continuously), instead of chance.



[size=5]Updating/Installing[/size]
Completed remove any previous version.
Drop the "HelpfulSpousesAndRoomates" folder into your Mods folder.

You can add or remove this mod from existing saves without issue.


[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]Though it isn’t in any way required, as always I recommend you use Generic Mod Config Menu if you intend to play around with the configs.

I tried to make it easy for this to co-exist with multi-spouse mods, but haven't done testing with this. I don't think anything will get weird but if it does, bug report with your SMAPI log and whatever poly mods you're using.

Mods that change marriage dialogue may or may not prevent your spouse/roommate from mentioning that they did chores, but the chores will still be done regardless.
